shared_elements: schematic human figures (row of crew strokes in A; anthropomorphic body in B)
repeated small marks arranged in a row/band
justification: The only overlap is generic: both use highly schematic, linear renderings of human-derived forms and repeated small marks in rows, which any tradition could produce independently. A depicts watercraft with crews — long hulls with rows of crew strokes and upturned prows — while B depicts a single monumental anthropomorphic figure with a face and relief motifs (rings, curved bands) on its body; no motif, relationship or arrangement is specifically shared.
